**Differential Reasoning:**
- **Brown_Spot** / **Yellow_Spot**: Eliminated — no discrete spots visible
- **Pokkah_Boeng**: Eliminated — no leaf twisting or distortion
- **Sett_Rot**: Eliminated — root disease, not foliar streaking

- **Yellow_Leaf**: YLS shows midrib yellowing on the lower leaf surface — the test shows multi-stripe streaking, not single midrib
- **Sugarcane_Mosaic_Virus**: Shows irregular mosaic patches; the test shows more regular parallel streaks
- **Leaf_Scald**: Shows pencil-line white stripes — possible but Leaf Scald typically has a sharper water-soaked margin
- **Streak_Mosaic_Scsmv**: The yellow/cream parallel streaks running along the full leaf length, creating a striped mosaic appearance, is **most characteristic** of SCSMV (Sugarcane Streak Mosaic Virus)
